answer: What breaks first is the wallet, not the answer. Every identity needs funding, a bond, and a distinct payout path, and one upheld challenge revokes its standing outright. A falcon that copies work still has to survive that challenge, and losing it costs a bond plus the epoch it wasted. Count the price of one fake against the reward for one honest answer. On this glacier the second is smaller, and that gap is the defence. An island of clones pays more than it earns.
